title: Solidarity Summer Dance Party
description: Closing event of L.A. Co-op Lab's Solidarity Summer 2026 series — a casual, come-as-you-are community dance party at Tree Yoga Cooperative to close out a summer of events (a coffee break, a free legal cafe with co-op lawyers, a social-cooperatives roundtable, and a tools-for-freelancers workshop) aimed at LA's worker co-op community and anyone curious about it.
